business_problem: Support operations dashboard data can silently mix duplicate ticket facts, missing routing metadata, refund-like negative amounts, and extreme outliers before publication.

issue_categories.name: Duplicate ticket identity
issue_categories.risk: Dashboards can double-count a support case or attach remediation to the wrong row.

issue_categories.evidence: 2 required routing fields missing across priority/team checks.
issue_categories.name: Missing routing metadata
issue_categories.risk: Support operations cannot reliably route or prioritize every ticket.

issue_categories.name: Negative customer-impact amount
issue_categories.risk: Refund-like events are mixed into positive customer-impact facts.

issue_categories.name: Extreme amount outlier
issue_categories.risk: Extreme values can skew reporting and need review before publication.

not_claimed: No customer production deployment is claimed.
This artifact measures a reproducible business-data case study, not enterprise adoption.

business_risk_areas.evidence: 1 duplicate ticket_id case can double-count support volume.
business_risk_areas.recommended_handoff: Deduplicate by the latest event timestamp, add idempotent merge logic, and enforce a uniqueness constraint in the pipeline.

business_risk_areas.evidence: 2 required routing fields are missing across priority and team.
business_risk_areas.recommended_handoff: Trace null generation for priority and team before publishing dashboard data.

business_risk_areas.evidence: 1 negative amount is mixed into positive customer-impact facts.
business_risk_areas.recommended_handoff: Validate refund handling and separate credit events from positive payment facts.

business_risk_areas.evidence: 1 amount outlier can skew aggregate customer-impact reporting.
business_risk_areas.recommended_handoff: Inspect source records for amount and decide whether to cap, filter, or correct them.

remediation_scorecard.resume_safe_outcome: Produced a verified remediation scorecard mapping 5 data quality findings to 4 business risk areas, 3 high-priority actions, and 4 owner handoffs.
sla_style_checks: priority and team must be present for routing
extreme amounts require review before dashboard publication
remediation_scorecard.summary: The agent converts raw quality findings into a prioritized remediation handoff for support-operations analytics owners.

resume_safe_summary: Quantified 4 support-ticket data quality issue categories across 8 rows, including duplicate ticket IDs, missing routing fields, negative amounts, and amount outliers.

top_root_cause_hypotheses.recommended_action: Separate refunds, credits, and exceptional values from standard fact tables or annotate them explicitly.
top_root_cause_hypotheses.title: Business-rule validation is not separating exceptional transactions from standard facts.

top_root_cause_hypotheses.recommended_action: Add idempotent merge logic and enforce a uniqueness check on the primary key.
top_root_cause_hypotheses.title: The ingestion pipeline may be replaying events without idempotent merge logic.

top_root_cause_hypotheses.recommended_action: Trace null generation for affected fields through the source API and transform layer.
top_root_cause_hypotheses.title: Source API or transform logic is producing incomplete fields for required analytics columns.
